stem:
The overall reaction for photosynthesis is shown.

$$6\text{CO}_2 + 6\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 + 6\text{O}_2$$

Water is oxidised in this process according to the following half-equation.

$$2\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{O}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 4\text{e}^-$$ half-equation 1

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Use these equations to deduce the half-equation for the reduction of carbon dioxide in this process.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Draw a fully labelled diagram of the apparatus that should be used to measure the standard electrode potential, $E^\ominus$, of $\text{O}_2(\text{g})$ in half-equation 1 under standard conditions. Include all necessary chemicals.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: For the cell drawn in (a)(ii), use the Data Booklet to calculate the $E^\ominus_{\text{cell}}$ and deduce which electrode is positive.
